crossRefs.note: Say among the nations, “Yahweh reigns.” The world is also established. It can’t be moved. He will judge the peoples…
Come near, you nations, to hear! Listen, you peoples. Let the earth and all it contains hear, the world, and everything…
“Hear Yahweh’s word, you nations, and declare it in the distant islands. Say, ‘He who scattered Israel will gather him…
“Declare among the nations and publish, and set up a standard; publish, and don’t conceal: say, ‘Babylon has been…

translations.web: Proclaim this among the nations: “Prepare for war! Stir up the mighty men. Let all the warriors draw near. Let them come up.
translations.bsb: Proclaim this among the nations: “Prepare for war; rouse the mighty men; let all the men of war advance and attack!
translations.kjv: Proclaim ye this among the Gentiles; Prepare war, wake up the mighty men, let all the men of war draw near; let them come up:
translations.asv: Proclaim ye this among the nations; prepare war; stir up the mighty men; let all the men of war draw near, let them come up.
